reviews.comment: Dr. Unterman is a gift to A&M. She cares deeply about her students and is always willing to help. If you attend class and put in the work you'll do fine!
The worst professor at A&M. Don't take her or this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tough class and Professor. Difficult materials.

I love this prof. Lecture is straightforward and interesting and assignments are manageable. You have to  participate to get credit, but the class is designed to make that easy to achieve and the discussions engage the class well. There are weekly discussions, 3 take home assignments, a group project. The class is manageable if you like law.
trying my hardest to do well in her class but lecture is hard to follow, and she is not the friendliest professor so it is hard to ask for help
Lots of participation needed to get an A in class. If you're quiet, forget about it. Lecture is ok but expectation for class is quite high.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I love this prof. Lecture is straightforward and interesting and assignments are manageable. You have to speak 10 times to get participation but the class is designed to make that easy to achieve and the discussions engage the class well, usually I don't like when profs do this but she does it in a reasonable manor.
Do not recommend her class
Not a good prof imo. Boring, monotonous. Really heavy on participation which I hate. tough and hard. Do not take this class!!! Waste of time and won't learn anything new.

Took her because of her ratings here, she is ok. Lots of weekly busy work, she has a tedious group project where she picks your partners, her exams are interpreting political cartoons and writing multiple short answer responses. Biggest knock is she grades participation heavily, but you can only gain points if she call on you and answer correctly.

I enjoyed this class even though I am not a history major! Attendance is not mandatory, but you get participation points for speaking out in class. I never spoke out in class, but I did all the skills assignments and tried my best on the take home essays and amicus brief and still passed the class. Best history class I could have taken!

Gave excellent, insightful lectures. Participation is required, you must talk 10 times in class throughout the semester. Fun group project doing a courtroom-style argument over a supreme court case. Definitely worth taking the class. 3 take-home exams and a paper over a SCOTUS case of your choice. If you're into history and law it will be easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good professor and you can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches but do not take this course if you don't like speaking up in class (participation pts). Also, beware if you're not very good with history or writing like a historian.. This course is meant for history majors/lovers, not for the weak!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is super great and I loved her lectures. Very good at presenting legal history in an unbiased way and encourages all perspectives. She's definitely willing to help out if you have extenuating circumstances and puts some lectures online if needed. No tests and only uses take-home essays for major grades with one big presentation.
Great prof. Must take for hist majors.

Dr. Unterman makes history so interesting! I enjoyed coming to her class despite being an 8 am, and attendance is mandatory (she takes grades on attendance). She has weekly quizzes over about 30-page long readings. Her tests are pretty straightforward as long as you take decent notes on her lecture slides. I really recommend taking her.

Mandatory attendance. Kind of intimidating, but gives really interesting lectures. No textbook, a quiz over readings each week (pretty manageable), and a couple writing assignments. Definitely do the two extra credit assignments at the end of the semester. All in all, a solid prof. Don't recommend taking as an 8am due to mandatory attendance.
GOAT Professor

History used to always be my least favorite subject until I took Dr.Unterman, and that completely changed! She is an amazing lecturer and makes them very engaging and interesting. Attendance is for a grade and the tests are based entirely on the lectures, but I promise you will not regret taking her!

I loved Dr. Unterman! I am an education major so was kinda scared for this course, but her lectures are very interesting! 2 midterms and an optional final, and 2 papers make up the bulk of your grade. Several extra credit opportunities at the end of the semester. Weekly discussion posts, only 250 words. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Unterman is a great professor. You can tell she loves her job and wants her students to succeed. There is no textbook and all the exams are based off only the lecture. As long as you write down something for every slide and study a decent amount outside of class you will do just fine.

Dr. Unterman is an amazing history professor. She's so knowledgeable and wonderfully presents the information in an interesting, and digestible manner. Her class is very well managed and fairly graded. She's also very responsive and willing to help you if you ask for help. I would recommend her for any of the classes that she teaches.

I enjoyed her lectures because she is never basis and her lectures are very informative. i ended up getting an A. There is a midterm paper and final paper (no tests). You will also have to write 2 major papers. Every week you have a quiz and discussion. You also have 2 debates. This class was a little more demanding but take her! Just work hard.
Plenty of reading. Monotonous. Has a clear perspective about history. Just agree with her and repeat what she says and you'll do great!

I love Professor Unterman! She is such an amazing teacher, I was always so excited to listen to her lectures. They are pre-recorded and are super interesting. After the lecture you take a super easy quiz and then you write two papers over the lecture information in the semester. TAKE HER! You won't regret it (:

Very lecture heavy, but she's great at explaining key terms. She is also straight to the point on her lectures. There are weekly quizzes that are easy. Also, weekly team debates are always interesting. The midterm and final are easy if you study lectures well - it's all written! There is also a paper that isn't too hard. Very helpful professor!!

HIST 280 can feel like a weed-out class to some, but with Professor Unterman, the class felt relatively easy. She provided a very clear structure and outline as to how we should complete the course. She provided lots of constructive criticism and feedback. I would highly anyone needing a history course to take one of her classes.

Professor Unterman is brilliant and carries herself as such. She is kind and dedicated to her students with a deliberate interest in their education. Her lectures are well thought out and interesting. Take her class if you can!

Unterman is by far my favorite professor I have had at Texas A&M. She makes lectures interesting and very straight forward. She is also very caring, encouraging and will help with any concerns you may have. All around wonderful person!

Great Prof and super clear. Tests are straight from lectures so if you show up and pay attention it will be an easy A. 4 novels to read with quizzes after each but the answers and questions are pretty straightforward and usually online. Key terms sheet for every exam (including final), if understand the sheet you will get an A on the exams.

One of my favorite profs! I've never done well in history, but she was clear & made it interesting. She really cares about her students. I ended with an 89.4, but I got an A on the cumulative final so she gave me an A! Tests are straight from lectures, & for her lectures she gives you a vocab sheet. 2 tests, 1 cumulative final, 1 paper, 4 quizzes

Loved Unterman! Made history very interesting for me, even though I liked history before already. 4 books you have to read that she gives quizzes on (but most quiz answers can be found online with some digging), one paper, and 3 tests. Exams are straight from lectures, which aren't posted online, so go to class. Very hard to not do well.

Great professor! Her lectures are very straight foward and to the point, but she keeps it interesting! There are 3 tests including the final, a paper, and 4 quizzes. She gives out key terms that outline her lectures and work well as a study guide for the tests. Tests are very straight forward and easy! Best part is NO textbook!!! HIGHLY recommend!

She is a really good professor with a really clear cut teaching style. She gives you key terms at the beginning of the year and teaches solely on that. She does not give a textbook, but you will have to read novels for online quizzes and one paper. Tests are not easy, but definitely not impossible. I generally hate history & loved this class.

Dr. Untertan's great, her tests are very straight forward and easy.  She gives reading quizzes but they are super easy too.  There is also one paper required but it is not too bad.  Her lectures are interesting and she does a good job of making the material easy to understand.  She will give you a page of key terms which will basically be the test.

She is a really good lecturer and gives you keys terms that help you follow her lecture, take notes, and study for her tests. There are 4 quizzes over 4 different books, but you get 10 points just for taking all of them! There are 3 tests which are all from the lectures, with the 3rd test being a cumulative test for the whole semester.

At the beginning of each unit she hands out a list of key terms that will be on the exam and then lectures off of them in order. If you go to class, take good notes, and then study then all you will get A's. There is three exams including the final and one paper! She is a great professor that is clear in the lectures and I would take again
the test are extremely easy if you take good notes at her lectures. only had to study for about 2 hours for every test
WONDERFUL!! absolutely loved her class! She explains things thoroughly and makes sure you know the test material, which may I say her tests are easy!

Tests are NOT essays! I love prof Unterman and would recommend taking her course! Class isn't mandatory, but tests are 100% based on notes from class. She doesn't assign a textbook, so you have to go to class for the notes, but you're saving money on a book you know you won't use. She is extremely helpful and understanding - go to her office hours!

A really cool professor that has a personal interest in both her students and her subject. The tests were all essays, which I personally find easier than multiple choice, but many don't. I would definitely take a class by her again and my only real regret is not taking the opportunity to get to know her better.
What else can I say about Dr. Unterman? She's simply wonderful! You'd have to be a fool to pass up the opportunity to take one of her classes.
